title: Case Endings and Dative Subjects
label: ch:ka-dative-case
canDo: I can say that I know Kannada the way Kannada itself says it — with no subject at all, marking myself with the dative -ge.

payoff.summary: Say ನನಗೆ ಕನ್ನಡ ಗೊತ್ತು — "to-me Kannada known" — set against ನಾನು ಕನ್ನಡ ಮಾತನಾಡುತ್ತೇನೆ, line up the four Dravidian datives -ge · -ukku · -ku · -ikku, rebuild -ige and -kke and say why Kannada's dative has g, then point to ದ in words you already say.
payoff.note: KA-C06-dative-subject assesses seven of the chapter's nine atoms: the dative -ge and its voiced-k history (KA-C06-dative-ge), stacking, the dative-subject sentence, and ದ (KA-S06-letter-da, now a prerequisite). The two left out, KA-SCRIPT-RECOG-114 (ೊ) and KA-SCRIPT-RECOG-115 (ಇ), are taught by script lessons sequenced after the payoff (332, 333).
